different.question: How is Blobus different from other apps?
different.short: An adaptive AI that adjusts to your level and goals in real time.
different.full:
Blobus works differently from ordinary language apps, where every learner goes through the same static lessons. Instead of gap-fill drills you hold a real, living dialogue with an AI that understands context, slang and cultural nuance, and corrects mistakes gently while you speak.

Our algorithm reads your learning style, pace and weak spots in real time and adjusts difficulty and topics to your personal goals. Whether you are preparing for an interview at a tech company or learning the language for travel, you get the effect of a personal tutor who is available 24/7, never gets tired and helps you get past the fear of speaking.

modes.question: Which learning modes are available?
modes.short: Everyday conversation, speaking practice, grammar and interview prep.
modes.full: Four modes: General English for everyday communication, Conversation Practice for speaking, Grammar for a deeper look at the rules, and Interview Prep for technical and behavioural interviews in English.

plans.question: What is the difference between Free and Pro?
plans.short: Free gives you 1 lesson and 20 messages a day; Pro gives you 10 lessons and 300 messages a day.
plans.full: Free includes 1 new lesson a day and 20 messages with the tutor a day. All modes, personalisation and memory are available on both plans, and answers can be played with the Listen button. Pro raises the limits to 10 lessons and 300 messages a day and adds the premium AI voice. The first 7 days of Pro are free and need no card.

cancel.question: How do I cancel Pro?
cancel.short: Cancel in the Subscription section; access lasts until the paid period ends.
cancel.full: You can cancel in the Subscription section with the Cancel button. No hidden conditions and no calls to support. Pro features stay available until the end of the paid period, after which the account moves to Free automatically.

languages.question: Can I learn other languages?
languages.short: Yes — the AI supports Spanish, French, German and more.
languages.full: Yes. Our AI supports Spanish, French, German, Italian and other languages. English is the main focus with the widest set of modes and features, but you can switch to any available language in your profile settings.

support.question: What if something doesn't work?
support.short: Write to support with the Help button and we'll reply within 24 hours.
support.full: If you run into a technical problem, write to support with the Help button in the app. We reply within 24 hours on business days and handle every case personally.

privacy.question: Are my data and conversations safe?
privacy.short: Yes — we never store or share your voice recordings with third parties.
privacy.full: Privacy comes first. Voice data is processed in real time and is not stored on our servers. Your text history is kept encrypted, used only for your progress and never leaves the platform.
